title: 2009 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: The triangular plot of land \(ACD\) lies between Aspen Road, Brown Road and a railroad. Main Street runs east and west, and the railroad runs north and south. The numbers in the diagram indicate distances in miles. The width of the railroad track can be ignored. How many square miles are in the plot of land \(ACD?\)

solutions.text:
The base of \(ADC\) is \(CD,\) which is \(3.\) The altitude is \(3\) as well.

Therefore, the area of \(ADC\) is \(\dfrac{1}{2} \cdot 3 \cdot 3 = 4.5.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Use \(CD\) as a base for triangle \(ACD.\)
The perpendicular distance from \(A\) to the railroad is shown by \(AB.\)
